# Ibis

> Ibis searches your reference libraries and gives you citations where you write.

## Guides

- [Connect an AI assistant](https://ibiscite.org/setup): Set up read-only access to your chosen Ibis libraries.
- [Command line and engine contract](https://github.com/ibiscite/ibis/blob/main/docs/cli.md): Commands, JSON and JSON-RPC.
- [MCP tools](https://github.com/ibiscite/ibis/blob/main/docs/cli.md#ai-agents-mcp): Read-only search, reference details, citations and styles.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/ibiscite/ibis/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): Local data and optional connections.
- [How to recognise official Ibis](https://github.com/ibiscite/ibis/blob/main/TRADEMARKS.md): Name and logo policy.
